fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the single driveway entrance clearly on both sides to help responders locate it without delay, especially in low-visibility conditions.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the access drive to allow emergency vehicles to pass without obstruction.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the main residence so responders can move around the building and identify entry points.
• Clear a turning or staging area within the property so emergency vehicles are not forced to reverse back to the road.
• Trim overgrowth around the detached structure so responders can reach and work around it without obstruction.
• Keep the walkway between the main residence and detached structure clear of vegetation so responders can move between the two buildings on foot.
• Mark any gates or access points along the walkway so responders can find them quickly without searching through surrounding vegetation.
• Keep a secondary exit route from the property clear in case the single access drive becomes blocked during an emergency.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim back all shrubs and low branches that are touching or directly next to the house on all sides.
• Remove any dead branches, leaves, or plant material that has collected against the house walls or under decks.
• Thin the tree clusters near the house to create open gaps between individual trees and between the trees and the structure.
• Raise the canopy of large trees close to the house by removing lower branches up to at least 10 feet from the ground.
• Separate shrubs and small plants growing beneath large trees so fire cannot climb from the ground into the tree canopy.
• Clear any brush, grass, or plant material growing immediately around any outbuildings or detached structures on the property.
• Cut back overhanging branches from large trees that extend directly over the roof or gutters.
• Keep the single driveway clear of overhanging branches, overgrown shrubs, and any debris along its full length so vehicles can pass through without obstruction.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is easy to find and navigate quickly under poor visibility conditions.
• Maintain a wide, clear turning area near the house so emergency vehicles can turn around without difficulty.
• Mow or cut down tall grass and low ground cover in open areas between the vegetation and the house.
